tools.description: List of Official Prometheus Documentation Files.
tools.name: docs_list

tools.description: Read the named markdown file containing official Prometheus documentation from the prometheus/docs repo

file.description: the name of the documentation file to read

tools.name: docs_read

tools.description: Search the markdown files containing official Prometheus documentation from the prometheus/docs repo

query.description: the query to search for in documentation

limit.description: maximum number of search results to return

tools.name: docs_search

tools.description: Returns the unique label names present in the block in sorted order by given time range and matches

matches.description: series selector arguments to filter label names

start_time.description: start timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to 5m ago.

end_time.description: end timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to current time.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation

tools.name: label_names

tools.description: Performs a query for the values of the given label, time range and matches

label.description: the label to query values for,required

matches.description: series selector arguments to filter label values

start_time.description: start timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to 5m ago.

end_time.description: end timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to current time.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation

tools.name: label_values

tools.description: Returns metadata about metrics currently scraped by the metric name.

metric.description: metric name to retrieve metadata for, all metrics if empty

limit.description: maximum number of metrics to return

tools.name: metric_metadata

tools.description: Execute an instant query against the Prometheus datasource, returning one value per series at a single point in time

timestamp.description: evaluation timestamp for the instant query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc. Defaults to current time.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation

tools.name: query

tools.description: Execute a range query against the Prometheus datasource, returning values over a time window; use for graphing and trend analysis

step.description: query resolution step width in Go duration format (e.g. '30s', '5m', '1h'), auto-set if unspecified

start_time.description: start timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to 5m ago.

end_time.description: end timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to current time.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation

tools.name: range_query

tools.description: List the runbooks embedded in this server: guided workflows (Agent Skills) for common Prometheus tasks - investigating error rates and alert spikes, finding top CPU/memory/disk consumers, troubleshooting missing metrics or empty query results, health-checking Prometheus, reducing high-cardinality metrics, reviewing and drafting recording and alerting rules, and tuning Prometheus configuration. Call this and read the matching runbook with runbooks_read before starting any of these tasks.
tools.name: runbooks_list

tools.description: Read the named runbook: a guided workflow (Agent Skill) for a common Prometheus task, expressed in terms of this server's tools. Follow its guidance when a user request matches a runbook's purpose; runbooks_list shows what is available.

name.description: the skill name of the runbook to read, as returned by runbooks_list (e.g. investigate-error-rates)

tools.name: runbooks_read

matches.description: series selector arguments that select the series to return,required

start_time.description: start timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to 5m ago.

end_time.description: end timestamp for the query. Accepts: Unix epoch seconds, RFC3339, or a duration string relative to now (e.g. 5m, 1h30m, etc). Defaults to current time.

truncation_limit.description: truncation limit for query response in number of lines/entries; use lower limits (e.g. 50-100) for initial exploration, set to -1 to disable truncation
